name: SaaSFame

sources.title: SaaSFame submit — redirects to login (email, Google, GitHub)
SaaSFame homepage — SaaS hall of fame directory

conditions: Free plan requires the SaaSFame badge displayed permanently on your site, enforced by automated re-checks (listing is unpublished without warning if the badge disappears)
Free queue is very long — the pricing page shows 874 tools waiting and review 'within 180 days', with rejection possible
requirements: Account required — /submit redirects to login (email/password, Google or GitHub)
SaaS/software product with a live site to host the badge (free path)
preparation: Product details: name, URL, description, categories/tags, logo, screenshots
Badge HTML ready to embed permanently for the free plan
Decide between Free, Basic ($14.9 one-time), or Pro ($49.9 one-time) before submitting
workflow: Register or sign in at saasfame.com
Open /submit and pick a plan (free listed behind the paid options)
On free: install the badge and wait up to ~180 days for review
On paid: listing is published immediately with 3 (Basic) or 5 (Pro) dofollow links
watchFor: Badge removal triggers automated checks that unpublish free listings with no warning — restoring requires upgrading to paid
Paid upsells stacked at checkout: Guest Post $79.9, Sponsor $79.9/30d, Directory Submissions $149 (100+ directories, 'DR 0 to 15+' claim)
Free listing can still be rejected after the wait
Operator runs sibling directories (toolfame.com, directoryfame.com, aitoolfame.com) — cross-promotion likely
countsAsLive: A product detail page on saasfame.com reachable from its category/tag listing pages.
unknowns: Real-world wait time vs the stated 180-day maximum
Whether free listings are nofollow or dofollow before badge verification
